about: The Display type (types/0x0022-display.md; zadania/zrobione/FEAT-12.md) on the simulator's `display`: ep4 a TEMPERATURE field with ContentTimeout, ep5 a 16-byte text field that keeps its own 120 s, ep6 a HUMIDITY field with text too. Content is reported on every change and on expiry; a write replaces whatever was shown and clears the other attribute; Text travels only in segments and is refused past TextLength (in bytes) or the node's 64-byte buffer.

steps.note: ep4 starts empty: Content NONE, Quantity TEMPERATURE, Value absent — and nothing was reported at start (types/0x0022-display.md §5.7)
Value = 21.37 °C: Content goes VALUE and is reported, before the reply
a new temperature: Content stays VALUE, nothing to report
Value reads back what is shown
Value = absent clears the field: Content NONE
a value of the wrong length for TEMPERATURE (i16)
Quantity is the device's, read-only (§5.2)
Text on a field without TEXT: UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, answered after the LAST segment
ContentTimeout: 0 or 60–3600 (§2.2)
the same value again RENEWS the content (§5.5)
59.999 s since the last write
60 s without renewal: the content expires, Content NONE is reported
and Value with it
ep5: TextLength 16, Content NONE
Text "Pranie gotowe" in three segments: Content TEXT reported, then ONE reply
Text is read in segments: SEGMENTED, then the value
an ordinary WRITE of a string is a wrong value — a string always travels in segments (02-typy-danych.md §2.2)
"Pranie skończone" is 17 BYTES: longer than TextLength, refused, nothing changes
a length prefix that disagrees with the data (05-mapowanie-can.md §6.6)
70 bytes — more than the node's 64-byte buffer: assembled to the end, refused
the text is still the one shown
no VALUE on ep5; no ContentTimeout either — the device keeps its own
119.999 s after the text was written
the device's own 120 s: the text expires
ep6 has both: a text first
Value = 45.20 % replaces the text (§5.1)
and the text reads back empty — the read matches the screen
an empty text clears the field and the value with it
Value reads absent
